technology: Python bounded JSON hooks and direct semantic checks
constraints: Two immutable UTF-8 byte inputs, each at most 65536 bytes and depth eight
At most sixteen cases and three method references per case
No commands, reference resolution, authority or physical approval
No specified native ABI or hard real-time deadline

alternatives.assessment: Declarative constraints are useful; raw-byte admission and report composition still require a host boundary.
Policy queries suit independently distributed rules. This fixed small checklist has no distribution requirement.
Streaming tokens are credible for larger input; this bounded complete-message API has no streaming requirement.
Typed native decoding is credible for native deployment; no current ABI or measured resource deficit selects it here.
Strict types reduce coercion but do not remove raw-token admission, relation checks or fixed-error wrapping.

rationale: Python object_pairs_hook and parse_int expose duplicate keys and numeric tokens before normalization. Exact immutable bytes allow hashing and both bounded contracts to share one input without a serialization bridge. Direct checks expose all independent findings. This is a qualitative mechanism decision, not a speed ranking.
reopen_when: A target native ABI is required
